# Lootura Press

An archive of personal bylines and source-linked articles collected by Lootura.

- [Spain](https://press.lootura.com/es/)
- [US](https://press.lootura.com/us/)
- [Sitemap](https://press.lootura.com/sitemap.xml)

Profiles are scoped to a publisher domain and a name. Matching names across publishers do not establish identity. Counts describe the collected archive, not a complete bibliography or a quality ranking. Portraits, when available, come from the publisher profile cited in the receipts. Always attribute reporting to the original publishers and authors.
